BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the homestead exemption amount; andamending RCW 6.13.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 6.13.030 and 1999 c 403 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A homestead may consist of lands, as described in RCW 6.13.010,regardless of area, but the homestead exemption amount shall not exceedthe lesser of (1) the total net value of the lands, mobile home,improvements, and other personal property, as described in RCW6.13.010, or (2) the sum of ((forty)) one hundred thousand dollars inthe case of lands, mobile home, and improvements, or the sum of fifteenthousand dollars in the case of other personal property described inRCW 6.13.010, except where the homestead is subject to execution,attachment, or seizure by or under any legal process whatever tosatisfy a judgment in favor of any state for failure to pay thatstate's income tax on benefits received while a resident of the stateof Washington from a pension or other retirement plan, in which event p. 1 SHB 1805there shall be no dollar limit on the value of the exemption.
